dict.string: Himawari reads what Music is playing so the wallpaper can show the album's animated artwork, and checks Finder's selection when you click the desktop.
Himawari measures how loud the song Music is playing is, to move the VU meters and spectrum on the wallpaper. Nothing is recorded.
Himawari listens for spoken commands like “next”, “pause” and “volume up” so you can control the music by voice. Recognition happens on this Mac; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Himawari turns the words you say into music commands like “next” or “pause”. The recognition runs on this Mac, and only those command words are listened for.
